name: Mahou Senshi Endless Desire
source:
A male student attending Hakuyou Academy is a passionate fan of magical warriors and always watches their activities from a distance in excitement. 
"I want to become friends with the magical warriors of the school administration." 
As he is thinking about this, he is suddenly approached by the magical warriors and asked to help with the preparations for an event at the school. It's like a dream come true for him, and he has a fun time with them. In the midst of it all, he ends up alone with Symphonic Lily. As they talk, Symphonic Lily begins to act in line with his envisioned desires. 
The male student becomes excited as he realizes that he can bring his own desires to life just by thinking about them, but they escalate and he starts revealing his shameful and embarrassing desires to the magical warriors. As he continues to act on his desires, he begins to undergo changes himself.
translation:
白耀学园的一名男学生，是魔法战士的热情粉丝，总会兴奋地从远处关注她们的活动。
“真想与学园执行部的魔法战士们成为朋友。”
正这样想着，他突然被魔法战士们搭话，请求协助筹备校内活动。梦想仿佛成真，他与她们一起度过了愉快时光。忙碌之中，他偶然与交响百合独处。交谈时，交响百合竟开始按照他心中想象的愿望行动。
男生兴奋地意识到，只要在心里想，愿望就能化作现实。可他的欲望不断升级，也开始向魔法战士们显露那些羞耻而难以启齿的心思。随着他不断将欲望付诸行动，自己也逐渐发生变化。
